def run_git(args, input_bytes=None):
    p = subprocess.run(["git"] + args, cwd=ROOT, input=input_bytes, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    git_children.append({"pid": p.pid, "exit": p.returncode, "stdout_bytes": len(p.stdout), "stderr_bytes": len(p.stderr)})
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git command failed: " + " ".join(args) + " stderr=" + p.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:1200])
    return p.stdout

def archive_inputs(rev, paths):
    raw = run_git(["archive", "--format=tar", rev] + list(paths))
    result = {}
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw), mode="r:") as tf:
        for member in tf.getmembers():
            if member.isfile():
                f = tf.extractfile(member)
                if f is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("archive member unreadable: " + member.name)
                result[member.name] = f.read()
    return result

def tree_paths(rev, path):
    raw = run_git(["ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", rev, "--", path])
    return [line for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines() if line]
